description: This file defines the 'Dimension' helper class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages measurement units such as centimeters, inches, pixels, etc., and provides methods for converting between different units related to spreadsheet cell dimensions.

classes.name: Dimension
classes.description: Helper class for managing and converting spreadsheet cell dimension units.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Dimension object by parsing a dimension string with optional units and converting the size to internal pixels or points.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width measurement in pixels or in the default cell dimension units.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height measurement, converting to points if necessary.

methods.name: toUnit
methods.description: Converts the internal size to a specified unit of measure, throwing an exception if the unit is invalid.
